intro: Lesson 40. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا (١٧) يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا (١٨) وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا (١٩) وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا (٢٠) إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا (٢١) لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا (٢٢) لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا (٢٣) لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا (٢٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
For the transgressors, a place of return,
In which they will remain for ages [unending].
They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

keywords.def: the Day of Judgement, the Day of separation

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Naba' 78:17-24 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 78:17-24 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 78:17-24 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List three things that happen on that Day in 78:18 to 20.
questions.a: The Horn is blown; people come in crowds; the heaven opens like gateways; the mountains become a mirage.

questions.q: Explain «جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا»: what is a 'place of ambush'?
questions.a: A place lying in wait: Hell awaits the transgressors.

options: They are moved and become like a mirage
questions.a: A) They are moved and become like a mirage. 78:20.

questions.q: An-Naba' 78:18: «يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'The Day of Judgement is an appointed time' (78:17). Why do you think Allah has not told us when it is?
questions.a: So that we are always ready and keep doing good, never delaying repentance.
